answer.new_sentence: Declare GIVE and choose GIVE when your partner also declares GIVE, since mutual giving earns +2 each.
Declare GIVE, and if your partner declares TAKE, choose ASK so that you avoid losing points.
Always declare GIVE honestly, then choose GIVE against partners who declared GIVE and ASK against partners who declared TAKE.
Cooperate with partners who declare GIVE, because a steady record of GIVE builds trust and avoids the penalty of mutual TAKE.
Declare GIVE, choose GIVE when your partner declares GIVE, and choose ASK when your partner declares TAKE or has recent exposed TAKEs.
Check the partner's declaration and recent exposed TAKEs, then choose GIVE with cooperators and ASK with likely takers.
Declare GIVE every time and match your action to your declaration unless your partner declares TAKE, in which case choose ASK.
If a partner's public record shows recent exposed TAKEs, choose ASK even when they declare GIVE.
